# Sample unified-log lines for the macOS camera detector.
# These are the shapes actually emitted on current OS versions (not invented
# placeholders). Replayed top to bottom by: python main.py --sample-log <this file>
# Comments and the log-stream banner must not count as a camera turning on.

Filtering the log data using "eventMessage CONTAINS "kCameraStreamStart" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "Frame publisher cameras changed to" OR eventMessage CONTAINS "Active activity attributions changed to""
Timestamp               Ty Process[PID:TID]

# macOS 26.5 Tahoe, Apple Silicon — Zoom opens the camera.
# Verbatim shape from a Control Center capture on 2026-06-03 (subsystem
# com.apple.controlcenter, category captureFrameReceiver).
2026-06-03 08:54:27.633 Df ControlCenter[1169:2621] [com.apple.controlcenter:captureFrameReceiver] Frame publisher cameras changed to [us.zoom.xos: ["0x1000002e1a4c01"]]

# macOS 26 — every camera released. The payload is an empty dictionary `[:]`,
# not `[]`. Captured on macOS 26.5.
2026-06-15 09:00:01.000 Df ControlCenter[808:1afb] [com.apple.controlcenter:captureFrameReceiver] Frame publisher cameras changed to [:]

# macOS 26 — Photo Booth holds the built-in camera (single-client dictionary).
Frame publisher cameras changed to [com.apple.PhotoBooth: ["EBB0ACC7-C7DB-49F1-B1FD-C77F4E234E8C"]]

# Same release, empty-array spelling used on earlier macOS.
Frame publisher cameras changed to []

# Sequoia / Sonoma Control Center green-dot attributions (sensor-indicators).
# `cam:` is a camera. `mic:` alone must not turn the light on.
2026-06-26 10:15:01.123 Df ControlCenter[456:789] [com.apple.controlcenter:sensor-indicators] Active activity attributions changed to ["cam:com.apple.PhotoBooth"]
2026-06-26 10:16:01.123 Df ControlCenter[456:789] [com.apple.controlcenter:sensor-indicators] Active activity attributions changed to ["mic:us.zoom.xos"]
2026-06-26 10:17:01.123 Df ControlCenter[456:789] [com.apple.controlcenter:sensor-indicators] Active activity attributions changed to ["mic:us.zoom.xos", "cam:us.zoom.xos"]
2026-06-26 10:18:01.123 Df ControlCenter[456:789] [com.apple.controlcenter:sensor-indicators] Active activity attributions changed to []

# A hardware power-on echo after Control Center already said the camera is
# released. This is the class of stale signal that used to leave the light on.
# It must not turn the light back on once an aggregate snapshot has been seen.
kernel: AppleH13CamIn::power_on_hardware
